summary.en: Ebola has reached an eighth province in eastern DRC, prompting alerts in Lubumbashi and border closures by Kenya and Uganda after 12 truck drivers were killed. The ADF continues attacks in Ituri while the FRN operates near Lubumbashi, and both UPDF and FARDC are conducting joint operations against ADF commanders in the region. A mercenary force suffered combat casualties in the Congo, and rebel-linked violence has led to civilian deaths. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Ebola har nådd en åttende provins i østlige DRC, noe som har utløst varsler i Lubumbashi og grenselukkinger fra Kenya og Uganda etter at 12 lastebilsjåfører ble drept. ADF fortsetter angrep i Ituri mens FRN opererer nær Lubumbashi, og både UPDF og FARDC gjennomfører felles operasjoner mot ADF-kommandanter i regionen. En leiesoldatstyrke fikk kamprelaterte tap i Kongo, og opprørsrelatert vold har ført til sivile dødsfall. Konflikten førte til 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
